principle: Every metric must identify its provenance as live/measured, emulated, or modelled.

GET /status.purpose: Node identity, ownership and runtime counters for the operations console.

GET /cache/stats.purpose: Expose value-cache telemetry. Witness/proof caches are deliberately root-scoped and separate.

POST /state/batch.purpose: Fetch multiple remote keys from one owner with a block-scoped deduplicated MPT witness.

POST /block/execute.purpose: Benchmark the prefix-partitioned execution pipeline without assuming K(B) is complete before execution.

cacheCoherence.valueCache: May survive block boundaries subject to state freshness/version checks.
cacheCoherence.witnessCache: Root-bound. Discard or explicitly re-anchor when the parent state root changes.

prefetchSemantics.rule: Prefetch is an optimization, never a correctness assumption.
prefetchSemantics.knownKeys: Access-list and trace-derived hints may be fetched concurrently before EVM execution.
prefetchSemantics.dynamicKeys: StateDB must retain a synchronous verified remote-miss fallback for runtime-discovered state.
